sub_problems.fills: When a gate answers a ticket's queueme and refuses, the trouble the ticket raises says the holder refused, in the same words every time, with the holder's reason in its detail, instead of saying no ha
sub_problems.what: D1: queueme words a holder's refusal as a fixed refusal why, the reason in detail.reason; bounce and silence keep the old wording; the identity is unchanged.
sub_problems.why: Measured 2026-11-16: all 12 occurrences of the 9 live ticket-unqueued-*-at-clearance troubles were codemother's clearance gate answering accepted False with a reason, and every why said 'no handler took it'. That is a false record of truth (Law 7): the reason stayed buried in detail.reply.
